intent: Translate these zebrafish mitochondrial protein-coding genes (complete CDSs with their stop codons) into protein sequences.
silent_error: seqkit translate defaults to translation table 1 (standard code, -T 1). Vertebrate mitochondrial genes use table 2: TGA codes Trp, ATA codes Met, AGA/AGG are stop codons. With the default table TGA gives internal '*' stops, ATA gives Ile instead of Met, and a terminal AGA/AGG reads through as Arg. The command exits 0 and writes ordinary FASTA protein records with no warning; the mitochondrial table is only available via -T 2.
